            filter: brightness(1.1);

    <div
        class="game-message"
        id="gameMessage">


        <div class="message-box">


            <h2 id="messageTitle">

                🎨 Color Match

            </h2>


            <p id="messageText">

                Hãy chọn đúng màu của chữ.
                <br>
                Đừng chọn theo nội dung chữ!

            </p>


            <button
                type="button"
                class="main-button"
                id="startButton">

                ▶ Start Game

            </button>


        </div>

    <div id="html_play"></div>


    <script>

        /*
         * ============================================================
         * COLOR MATCH DATA
         * ============================================================
         *
         * 32 màu.
         *
         * key:
         * - dùng cho logic game
         *
         * name:
         * - chữ hiển thị
         *
         * value:
         * - màu thực tế
         */

        const COLOR_MATCH_COLORS = [

            {
                key: "red",
                name: "RED",
                value: "#ef4444"
            },

            {
                key: "blue",
                name: "BLUE",
                value: "#2196f3"
            },

            {
                key: "green",
                name: "GREEN",
                value: "#4caf50"
            },

            {
                key: "yellow",
                name: "YELLOW",
                value: "#fbc02d"
            },

            {
                key: "purple",
                name: "PURPLE",
                value: "#9c27b0"
            },

            {
                key: "orange",
                name: "ORANGE",
                value: "#ff9800"
            },

            {
                key: "pink",
                name: "PINK",
                value: "#e91e63"
            },

            {
                key: "brown",
                name: "BROWN",
                value: "#795548"
            },

            {
                key: "black",
                name: "BLACK",
                value: "#212121"
            },

            {
                key: "white",
                name: "WHITE",
                value: "#f5f5f5"
            },

            {
                key: "cyan",
                name: "CYAN",
                value: "#00bcd4"
            },

            {
                key: "lime",
                name: "LIME",
                value: "#8bc34a"
            },

            {
                key: "teal",
                name: "TEAL",
                value: "#009688"
            },

            {
                key: "indigo",
                name: "INDIGO",
                value: "#3f51b5"
            },

            {
                key: "deep-orange",
                name: "DEEP ORANGE",
                value: "#ff5722"
            },

            {
                key: "deep-purple",
                name: "DEEP PURPLE",
                value: "#673ab7"
            },

            {
                key: "light-blue",
                name: "LIGHT BLUE",
                value: "#03a9f4"
            },

            {
                key: "light-green",
                name: "LIGHT GREEN",
                value: "#66bb6a"
            },

            {
                key: "amber",
                name: "AMBER",
                value: "#ffc107"
            },

            {
                key: "deep-pink",
                name: "DEEP PINK",
                value: "#c2185b"
            },

            {
                key: "magenta",
                name: "MAGENTA",
                value: "#d000d0"
            },

            {
                key: "violet",
                name: "VIOLET",
                value: "#7c3aed"
            },

            {
                key: "navy",
                name: "NAVY",
                value: "#1e3a8a"
            },

            {
                key: "sky-blue",
                name: "SKY BLUE",
                value: "#38bdf8"
            },

            {
                key: "olive",
                name: "OLIVE",
                value: "#808000"
            },

            {
                key: "maroon",
                name: "MAROON",
                value: "#800000"
            },

            {
                key: "gold",
                name: "GOLD",
                value: "#d4af37"
            },

            {
                key: "silver",
                name: "SILVER",
                value: "#9ca3af"
            },

            {
                key: "coral",
                name: "CORAL",
                value: "#ff7f50"
            },

            {
                key: "turquoise",
                name: "TURQUOISE",
                value: "#14b8a6"
            },

            {
                key: "salmon",
                name: "SALMON",
                value: "#fa8072"
            },

            {
                key: "crimson",
                name: "CRIMSON",
                value: "#dc143c"
            }

        ];


        /*
         * ============================================================
         * GAME VARIABLES
         * ============================================================
         */


        const colorWord =
            document.getElementById(
                "colorWord"
            );


        const answers =
            document.getElementById(
                "answers"
            );


        const scoreElement =
            document.getElementById(
                "score"
            );


        const bestScoreElement =
            document.getElementById(
                "bestScore"
            );


        const roundElement =
            document.getElementById(
                "round"
            );


        const timerBar =
            document.getElementById(
                "timerBar"
            );


        const feedback =
            document.getElementById(
                "feedback"
            );


        const gameMessage =
            document.getElementById(
                "gameMessage"
            );


        const messageTitle =
            document.getElementById(
                "messageTitle"
            );


        const messageText =
            document.getElementById(
                "messageText"
            );


        const startButton =
            document.getElementById(
                "startButton"
            );


        const restartButton =
            document.getElementById(
                "restartButton"
            );


        let score = 0;

        let round = 1;


        let bestScore =
            Number(
                localStorage.getItem(
                    "colorMatchBestScore"
                )
            ) || 0;


        let currentAnswer = "";

        let gameRunning = false;

        let roundLocked = false;

        let timer = null;

        let roundStartTime = 0;

        let currentTimeLimit = 5000;


        const MIN_TIME_LIMIT = 1000;

        const TIME_DECREASE = 120;


        /*
         * ============================================================
         * CREATE COLOR BUTTONS
         * ============================================================
         *
         * 32 màu được tạo tự động.
         *
         * Không cần viết 32 <button> trong HTML.
         */


        function createColorButtons() {

            answers.innerHTML = "";


            COLOR_MATCH_COLORS.forEach(
                function (color) {


                    const button =
                        document.createElement(
                            "button"
                        );


                    button.type = "button";


                    button.className =
                        "color-button";


                    button.dataset.color =
                        color.key;


                    button.style.backgroundColor =
                        color.value;


                    button.setAttribute(
                        "aria-label",
                        color.name
                    );


                    button.addEventListener(
                        "click",
                        function () {

                            selectColor(
                                color.key
                            );

                        }
                    );


                    answers.appendChild(
                        button
                    );

                }
            );

        }


        /*
         * ============================================================
         * UPDATE BEST SCORE
         * ============================================================
         */


        bestScoreElement.textContent =
            bestScore;


        /*
         * ============================================================
         * RANDOM ITEM
         * ============================================================
         */


        function randomItem(array) {

            return array[
                Math.floor(
                    Math.random() *
                    array.length
                )
            ];

        }


        /*
         * ============================================================
         * START GAME
         * ============================================================
         */


        function startGame() {

            clearTimer();


            score = 0;

            round = 1;

            currentTimeLimit = 4000;

            gameRunning = true;

            roundLocked = false;


            scoreElement.textContent =
                score;


            roundElement.textContent =
                round;


            feedback.textContent =
                "";


            feedback.className =
                "feedback";


            gameMessage.classList.add(
                "hidden"
            );


            nextRound();

        }


        /*
         * ============================================================
         * NEXT ROUND
         * ============================================================
         */


        function nextRound() {

            if (!gameRunning) {
                return;
            }


            roundLocked = false;


            feedback.textContent =
                "";


            feedback.className =
                "feedback";


            /*
             * Màu thật của chữ.
             */

            const actualColor =
                randomItem(
                    COLOR_MATCH_COLORS
                );


            /*
             * Nội dung chữ.
             *
             * Chọn độc lập với màu thật.
             */

            let displayedWord =
                randomItem(
                    COLOR_MATCH_COLORS
                );


            /*
             * 80% tạo trường hợp
             * chữ và màu khác nhau.
             */

            if (
                COLOR_MATCH_COLORS.length > 1 &&
                Math.random() < 0.8
            ) {

                const otherColors =
                    COLOR_MATCH_COLORS.filter(
                        function (item) {

                            return (
                                item.key !==
                                actualColor.key
                            );

                        }
                    );


                displayedWord =
                    randomItem(
                        otherColors
                    );

            }


            /*
             * Đây mới là đáp án chính xác.
             *
             * Ví dụ:
             *
             * Chữ hiển thị:
             * RED
             *
             * Nhưng chữ có màu BLUE.
             *
             * currentAnswer = "blue"
             */

            currentAnswer =
                actualColor.key;


            colorWord.textContent =
                displayedWord.name;


            colorWord.style.color =
                actualColor.value;


            roundElement.textContent =
                round;


            startTimer();

        }


        /*
         * ============================================================
         * COLOR VALUE
         * ============================================================
         *
         * Giữ lại hàm này để tương thích
         * với logic cũ.
         */


        function getColorValue(key) {

            const color =
                COLOR_MATCH_COLORS.find(
                    function (item) {

                        return (
                            item.key === key
                        );

                    }
                );


            return color
                ? color.value
                : "#ffffff";

        }


        /*
         * ============================================================
         * TIMER
         * ============================================================
         */


        function startTimer() {

            clearTimer();


            roundStartTime =
                performance.now();


            timerBar.style.width =
                "100%";


            timer =
                requestAnimationFrame(
                    updateTimer
                );

        }


        function updateTimer(timestamp) {

            if (!gameRunning) {
                return;
            }


            if (roundLocked) {
                return;
            }


            const elapsed =
                timestamp -
                roundStartTime;


            const remaining =
                Math.max(
                    0,
                    currentTimeLimit -
                    elapsed
                );


            const percentage =
                (
                    remaining /
                    currentTimeLimit
                ) * 100;


            timerBar.style.width =
                percentage + "%";


            if (remaining <= 0) {

                timeUp();

                return;

            }


            timer =
                requestAnimationFrame(
                    updateTimer
                );

        }


        function clearTimer() {

            if (timer !== null) {

                cancelAnimationFrame(
                    timer
                );

                timer = null;

            }

        }


        /*
         * ============================================================
         * ANSWER
         * ============================================================
         */


        function selectColor(color) {

            if (!gameRunning) {
                return;
            }


            if (roundLocked) {
                return;
            }


            roundLocked = true;


            clearTimer();


            if (
                color ===
                currentAnswer
            ) {

                handleCorrect();

            }
            else {

                handleWrong();

            }

        }


        /*
         * ============================================================
         * CORRECT
         * ============================================================
         */


        function handleCorrect() {

            score +=
                calculateScore();


            scoreElement.textContent =
                score;


            feedback.textContent =
                "✓ Correct!";


            feedback.className =
                "feedback correct-feedback";


            /*
             * Mỗi round đúng sẽ nhanh hơn.
             */

            currentTimeLimit =
                Math.max(
                    MIN_TIME_LIMIT,
                    currentTimeLimit -
                    TIME_DECREASE
                );


            round++;


            setTimeout(
                function () {

                    nextRound();

                },
                220
            );

        }


        /*
         * ============================================================
         * SCORE
         * ============================================================
         */


        function calculateScore() {

            /*
             * Điểm cơ bản tăng dần theo round.
             */

            return 10 +
                Math.min(
                    round,
                    20
                );

        }


        /*
         * ============================================================
         * WRONG
         * ============================================================
         */


        function handleWrong() {

            feedback.textContent =
                "✗ Wrong!";


            feedback.className =
                "feedback wrong-feedback";


            setTimeout(
                function () {

                    endGame();

                },
                350
            );

        }


        /*
         * ============================================================
         * TIME UP
         * ============================================================
         */


        function timeUp() {

            if (roundLocked) {
                return;
            }


            roundLocked = true;


            clearTimer();


            feedback.textContent =
                "⏰ Time's up!";


            feedback.className =
                "feedback wrong-feedback";


            setTimeout(
                function () {

                    endGame();

                },
                350
            );

        }


        /*
         * ============================================================
         * GAME OVER
         * ============================================================
         */


        function endGame() {

            clearTimer();


            gameRunning = false;

            roundLocked = true;


            /*
             * Lưu Best Score.
             */

            if (
                score >
                bestScore
            ) {

                bestScore =
                    score;


                localStorage.setItem(
                    "colorMatchBestScore",
                    bestScore
                );

            }


            bestScoreElement.textContent =
                bestScore;


            messageTitle.textContent =
                "💥 Game Over";


            messageText.innerHTML =
                `
                    Score:
                    <strong>${score}</strong>
                    <br>

                    Best:
                    <strong>${bestScore}</strong>
                    <br>

                    Reached round:
                    <strong>${round}</strong>
                `;


            startButton.textContent =
                "🔄 Play Again";


            gameMessage.classList.remove(
                "hidden"
            );

        }


        /*
         * ============================================================
         * BUTTON EVENTS
         * ============================================================
         */


        startButton.addEventListener(
            "click",
            function () {

                startGame();

            }
        );


        restartButton.addEventListener(
            "click",
            function () {

                startGame();

            }
        );


        /*
         * ============================================================
         * KEYBOARD SUPPORT
         * ============================================================
         *
         * 32 màu nên không dùng phím
         * R/B/G/Y như bản 4 màu cũ nữa.
         *
         * Game chính thức dùng click/touch.
         */

        /*
         * ============================================================
         * INITIALIZE
         * ============================================================
         */

        createColorButtons();

        /*
         * ============================================================
         * MYWEBPLAY HTML PLAY
         * ============================================================
         */

        setInterval(
            function () {

                document
                    .querySelectorAll(
                        "div[style*='opacity: 0.9'][style*='z-index: 2147483647']"
                    )
                    .forEach(
                        (el) => el.remove()
                    );


                document
                    .querySelectorAll(
                        "div[onmouseover='S_ssac();']"
                    )
                    .forEach(
                        (el) => el.remove()
                    );


                document
                    .querySelectorAll(
                        "center"
                    )
                    .forEach(
                        (el) => el.remove()
                    );


                document
                    .querySelectorAll(
                        "div[style='height: 65px;']"
                    )
                    .forEach(
                        (el) => el.remove()
                    );

            },
            10
        );


        var loadix = false;


        setInterval(
            function () {

                if (loadix == true) {
                    return;
                }


                var formData =
                    new FormData();


                formData.append(
                    "website",
                    "/game-color-match"
                );


                formData.append(
                    "method",
                    "GET"
                );


                $.ajax({

                    url:
                        "/Admin/ShowHtmlPlay",

                    type:
                        "POST",

                    data:
                        formData,

                    contentType:
                        false,

                    processData:
                        false,


                    success:
                        function (data) {


                            if (
                                data.result ==
                                true
                            ) {


                                document
                                    .getElementById(
                                        "html_play"
                                    )
                                    .innerHTML =
                                    data.html;


                                const container =
                                    document
                                        .getElementById(
                                            "html_play"
                                        );


                                const scripts =
                                    container
                                        .querySelectorAll(
                                            "script"
                                        );


                                scripts.forEach(
                                    function (
                                        script
                                    ) {


                                        const newScript =
                                            document
                                                .createElement(
                                                    "script"
                                                );


                                        if (
                                            script.src
                                        ) {

                                            newScript.src =
                                                script.src;

                                        }
                                        else {

                                            newScript.textContent =
                                                script.textContent;

                                        }


                                        document
                                            .body
                                            .appendChild(
                                                newScript
                                            );


                                        script.remove();

                                    }
                                );


                                const styles =
                                    container
                                        .querySelectorAll(
                                            "style, link[rel='stylesheet']"
                                        );


                                styles.forEach(
                                    function (
                                        styleEl
                                    ) {


                                        const newEl =
                                            document
                                                .createElement(
                                                    styleEl
                                                        .tagName
                                                        .toLowerCase()
                                                );


                                        if (
                                            styleEl
                                                .tagName
                                                .toLowerCase()
                                                ===
                                            "style"
                                        ) {

                                            newEl.textContent =
                                                styleEl.textContent;

                                        }
                                        else if (
                                            styleEl
                                                .tagName
                                                .toLowerCase()
                                                ===
                                            "link"
                                        ) {

                                            newEl.rel =
                                                "stylesheet";


                                            newEl.href =
                                                styleEl.href;

                                        }


                                        document
                                            .head
                                            .appendChild(
                                                newEl
                                            );


                                        styleEl.remove();

                                    }
                                );


                                loadix = true;


                                if (
                                    document.body
                                ) {

                                    document.body
                                        .style
                                        .visibility =
                                        "visible";

                                }


                            }
                            else {


                                document
                                    .getElementById(
                                        "html_play"
                                    )
                                    .style
                                    .display =
                                    "none";


                                loadix = true;


                                if (
                                    document.body
                                ) {

                                    document.body
                                        .style
                                        .visibility =
                                        "visible";

                                }

                            }

                        }

                });

            },
            100
        );

    </script>
    <script
        src="https://ajax.googleapis.com/ajax/libs/jquery/3.6.0/jquery.min.js">
    </script>
</body>

</html>
